comment: PUNCH is not an attack control. The README says "PUNCH control: 0% to 100% (attack time: 0%=5ms slow, 100%=0.1ms fast/punchy)"; in the code the knob value is loaded into punchEnvelope on every closed-to-open transition and the gain becomes smoothedGain * (1 + punchEnvelope), decaying with a 15ms time constant (src/Shape.cpp:226-227, 240, 296). Attack time comes only from the menu slider, 0.1ms to 25ms. The GATE knob is marked in dB but the mapping is linear in voltage: (dB + 60)/60 times 80% of the reference, so -60dB is 0V and 0dB is 4V at the 5V reference (src/Shape.cpp:171-176). The sidechain is chosen by getChannels() > 0, which is the same test as isConnected() here. The gate attenuation meter is driven from the left channel only (src/Shape.cpp:835).
